rootCause.statement: apps/web/src/voice/parakeet.worker.ts overrode env.wasm.wasmPaths with the non-JSEP ONNX Runtime artifacts while the imported ORT build is the JSEP/WebGPU bundle, so ORT dynamically imported a WASM glue module that does not match the runtime and initialisation threw.
evidence: onnxruntime-web@1.24.1 package exports map: the bare 'onnxruntime-web' import in a browser resolves to dist/ort.bundle.min.mjs.

grep of dist/ort.bundle.min.mjs references only ort-wasm-simd-threaded.jsep.mjs and .jsep.wasm and contains JSEP symbols; dist/ort.wasm.bundle.min.mjs is the build that references the plain ort-wasm-simd-threaded.mjs/.wasm.
lib/wasm/wasm-utils-import.ts line 248: any urlOverride or prefixOverride disables the embedded-glue path, so the override is what selects the mismatched module.
parakeet.js@1.4.4 src/backend.js line 54 only assigns wasmPaths when unset, so it never corrects the override.
The failure was invisible because parakeetTranscription.ts discarded the worker ErrorEvent and replaced every failure with one fixed string.

disproven.hypothesis: Threaded ORT build requires SharedArrayBuffer, so cross-origin isolation is missing.
disproven.evidence: onnxruntime-web 1.24.1 ships only threaded artifacts and lib/wasm/wasm-factory.ts lines 132-149 force numThreads to 1 when SharedArrayBuffer is absent; parakeet.js src/backend.js lines 67-73 also forces 1 thread in that case. cpuThreads is already 1. Adding COOP/COEP would break the Hugging Face model fetch for no gain.

disproven.hypothesis: The packaged desktop CSP blocks the worker or the model download.
disproven.evidence: makeDesktopContentSecurityPolicy already allows worker-src 'self' for the same-origin module worker, connect-src https: for huggingface.co, and script-src 'wasm-unsafe-eval'. The custom scheme is registered standard, secure, supportFetchAPI and corsEnabled, so IndexedDB caching and fetch are available. No upstream CSP edit is required.
